provenance.promptSummary: Compact abandoned wooden apple press with fallen apples and moss; no sign or text.
Warm amber lantern hanging from a simple hook on a short islet post; tightly contained light and no notice board.
Low concealed reed-and-wood wildlife hide with a viewing gap; no readable notice.
Compact snow-covered rock ledge beside a narrow frozen cascade.
Low mossy orchard wall with a clear central breach and loose stones; not a boulder pile.
Shallow hand-cut recess in an upright quarry rock face with a few cut blocks.
Broad, low natural rock ledge on the basin rim with a flat viewing shelf.
Warm red-amber cliffside shelf shaped for small creatures to bask; not a tall spire or marker.
Low circular dry stone well with moss, empty opening, and a subtle nonverbal carving; no plaque.
Versioned edit of the canonical oak prop with a subtle natural trunk hollow; existing tree-oak is unchanged.
